thought.text: The UI 500 was caused by workspace plugin packages not being built (`@sva/plugin-generic-items` entry unresolved). I've now run `pnpm build` (all 35 projects, exit 0) and restarted. Let me re-verify the UI page and the IAM context endpoint.

reasoning_content:
The UI 500 error is caused by the workspace plugin packages not being built (vite can't resolve the `@sva/plugin-generic-items` entry). In local development, the workspace packages need to be built into `dist/`. Let me check if the dist folders exist — maybe the dev server needs the workspace libs built first. The `pnpm build` built all 35 projects. Let me check if the plugin packages now have dist, and whether the dev server (vite) can now resolve them.

Actually, in the dev server the vite config uses workspace packages. Let me check how the dev server resolves `@sva/plugin-generic-items`. The error was "Failed to resolve entry for package @sva/plugin-generic-items". This is because the package's dist/ wasn't built. Now that I ran `pnpm build` (which built all projects including plugin-generic-items), the dist should exist.

But wait — the dev server was already running. Vite's module resolution for workspace packages points to their dist via package.json exports. Since I built the packages, now the dist exists. But the running vite server may have cached the failure. Let me restart the dev server and re-test GET /.

Actually the restart I just did should have picked up the built dist. Let me re-test GET / and the IAM context.
